note: Legend portraits, Goblin pilot (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Sewer Imp
legends.subject: a small wiry gutter imp crouched at the mouth of an old stone drain, grey-green mottled skin, long pointed ears, sharp crooked teeth in a sly grin, wet ragged sackcloth, a rusted short knife held close to his chest.

legends.name: Kobold
legends.subject: a German mine kobold, a small wizened man with a long grey beard and leathery face, a pointed brown felt hood, a miner's leather apron, holding a dim oil lamp in a timbered silver-mine tunnel, a spiteful narrow-eyed look.

legends.name: Nain Rouge
legends.subject: the Nain Rouge of the Detroit river, a small red-skinned dwarf with burning dark eyes, wild matted black hair and beard, a tattered old 18th-century French coat and fur boots, a misty riverbank behind him, an ominous mocking smile.

legends.name: Andvari
legends.subject: Andvari the Norse dwarf, a stooped old dwarf with a braided grey beard, soaked hair, standing at the foot of a dark waterfall, clutching a heavy plain gold ring to his chest, bitter cursing expression, a pike fish glinting in the water below.

legends.name: Alberich
legends.subject: Alberich the dwarf lord of the Nibelungs, a stern broad-shouldered dwarf with a forked iron-grey beard, a heavy grey hooded cloak half fading into shadow, crouched over a cave hoard of old gold coins and cups, guarded watchful eyes.

legends.name: Rumpelstiltskin
legends.subject: Rumpelstiltskin from the Grimm tale, a gnarled little old man with a long thin beard and a hooked nose, a patched brown jerkin and pointed cap, sitting at a wooden spinning wheel with straw turning into gold thread, a greedy knowing grin.

legends.name: Puck
legends.subject: Puck the English hobgoblin, a lean wild-haired rustic sprite with pointed ears and a mischievous grin, dressed in rough brown leather and oak leaves, holding a small lantern in a dark foggy night wood.

legends.name: Reynard the Fox
legends.subject: Reynard the Fox from the medieval beast fables, a fox with a red-brown pelt standing upright like a man, wearing a worn medieval monk's hooded habit over a leather jerkin, sly narrowed amber eyes, one paw raised as if making a persuasive speech.

legends.name: Hermes
legends.subject: Hermes of archaic Greek myth, a lean young man with curly dark hair, a wide-brimmed bronze-grey traveller's hat with small wings, a plain wool cloak pinned at the shoulder, holding a herald's staff, a clever sidelong smile, as painted on an ancient Greek vase brought to life.

legends.name: Loki
legends.subject: Loki the Norse trickster god as described in the Eddas, a handsome sharp-featured man with long unkempt red-blond hair and a short beard, scarred lips once sewn shut, a Viking-age wool tunic and fur cloak, iron fetters on his wrists, no helmet, no horns, a cold amused smile.
